text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from finishing our errands,
Sounds of Earth invited me to come listen to a recital at a music school.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My heart still hasn't stopped racing...!
Every girl's performance was brimming with passionâit was benissimo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The recital had already come to an end.
The audience had completely cleared out,
leaving me alone with Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"How nostalgic. I participated in a recital once, too.
An acquaintance of my mother who owned a music school was kind enough to let me join."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, this music classroom has basically been my alma mater.
That's why I drop by every now and then.
choice_data_list: You must have really enjoyed the recital.
You must have really enjoyed the recital.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sì...! I still vividly remember the emotional impact of that moment.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"For as long as I can remember,
I was having jam sessions with my mother and the orchestra members.
Naturally, it was a time overflowing with happiness."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "Yet the first time I performed on stage, my melody resonated with unprecedented power, carrying the burning passion in my heart far and wide!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The acoustics of the hall producing delicate resonance,
the joy of wearing a glittering dress,
the audience swaying and holding their breath...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...The melody riding over the accompaniment, such fantastico music made my heart dance!
Something I could never play alone...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Racing is the same way.
I can't create the ultimate session all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"The crew setting the stage, the musicians layering melodies,
the cheering audience, and...!!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I need your power to wield the baton...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Direttore, the reason I brought you here today
was to tell you that.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Direttrice, the reason I brought you here today
was to tell you that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having gone out with her several times now,
there was something I came to realize.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I'm surprised that caught you off guard.
You're quite the attentive one yourself, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I couldn't understand at the time why she called it "unexpected." Becauseâ

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"However... you mustn't mistake self-sacrifice for love, Direttore.
I fear for your well-being."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"However... you mustn't mistake self-sacrifice for love, Direttrice.
I fear for your well-being."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I ended up making her worry about me, showing that I was in no state to claim I had everything under careful control.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through picking out shoes,
I learned that she needed self-care to perform her best session. However—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"The sound of my shoes and the performers' echoing across the track...
A resonance woven of tension and excitement!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Do you realize how fantastico this is?!
It's the sound you gave me.
Because that day, you conducted for me!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I truly... thank you from the bottom of my heart!
No one else could ever be my Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In order for her to enjoy the session,
she needed her Trainer's help,
and she had been relying on me all along.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
What is it?
choice_data_list: I want to create the ultimate session with you!
I want to make the best session ever with you!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
'O sole mio!!
Of course! Together, you and I
shall surely create it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I must do better.
Even a conductor is indispensable to the session, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Benissimo... Ah!
You are so enchanting, my happiness knows no bounds!!
Are you a sorcerer, perhaps?!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I can bear it no longer!
Come with me, my conductor!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I can bear it no longer!
Come with me, my conductor!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Led by the hand, I ended up right on the empty stage...
choice_data_list: Is it okay to go in without permission?
Is it okay to go in without permission?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all!
The signora... the owner of the music school,
told me I could use it, you see.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now—let me hear your resolve, your dream!
An overture alone is simply not enough!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heartbeats, breaths, expressions, even the sparkle in their eyes—
Surely it all reaches her as "sound."
Everything that has not yet been put into words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then let us play the passion within our hearts.
Let us deliver our cherished wish.
—To do that, how should we shake these maracas?"
choice_data_list: (Light on my feet, filled with hope)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Agilmente...
To think you would hold such feelings toward me!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Very well, I shall answer your expectations.
I will make sure my sound reaches you!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the empty theater, a duet of violin and maracas resonated. For a while, we surrendered to the delightful melody, immersed in a wordless dialogue...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Energico! Ah, I can feel it vibrating right through me!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (You truly understand me. To hold such burning passion for my sake... what a blessed soul I am!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the empty theater, a duet of violin and maracas resonated. For a while, we surrendered to the passionate rhythm, immersed in a wordless dialogue...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Prezza...?
You felt that way about me?!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(A clear, pristine sound free of noise...
I have immense respect for you as well.
More than anyone else I have ever met.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the empty theater, a duet of violin and maracas resonated. For a while, we surrendered to the flowing harmony, immersed in a wordless dialogue...
